title: Table partitioning and data lifecycle
brief: Choose a partition boundary for useful pruning or retention without assuming it distributes work across servers. Derive pruning from predicates and account for global identity, references and safe partition retirement.

title: Sharding and distributed SQL
brief: Choose a distribution boundary from local work, invariant scope and the actual bottleneck. Distinguish replicas from shards, explain authoritative replicated history, acknowledgements and quorum availability, and separate agreement within one partition from atomic commit across partitions. Derive locality, skew, fan-out and coordination from the key.

neighbouring_ownership.placement: Owns latency and survival across failure domains.
neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns copied-history progress and read routing; distribution establishes quorum-based agreement within one replicated partition.

title: Inside PostgreSQL
brief: Trace one connection and request through PostgreSQL processes, shared buffers, heap tuples and indexes. Explain tuple visibility, HOT updates and their physical limits so native plans and maintenance have a concrete physical setting.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns retained horizons and transaction-age maintenance.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns durability controls and crash drills.

title: Upgrading and migrating PostgreSQL
brief: Choose between a major upgrade and a logical migration, then rehearse compatibility, a recoverable write handover and acceptance. Identify the point after which a simple return is no longer possible.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns the PostgreSQL-to-CockroachDB application contract transfer.

title: Moving a SQL application to CockroachDB
brief: Find semantic incompatibilities behind similar SQL, then port the application contract. Validate a consistent copy, transfer one write authority and reconcile a return path with explicit limits once new writes are accepted.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-backup: Owns native backup and restore scope.
